MSV.NoTokens: Stream View: no tokens with vision that this user can observe in this scene.
MSV.Panel.StreamLevelHint: The stream shows one level of this scene at a time. Panes following a token on another level show where that token is instead.
MSV.Settings.ShowPaneLabels.Name: Show pane labels
MSV.Settings.ShowPaneLabels.Hint: Shows who or what each pane is following in its bottom-left corner. Warnings, such as a token the stream can't see through, always show.
MSV.Settings.HoldMessage.Name: Hold screen message
MSV.Settings.HoldMessage.Hint: Shown on the stream while you have it on hold. Also editable from the Stream Panes panel.
MSV.Panel.ZoomHint: Grid squares top to bottom for this pane. Leave blank to use the module setting.
MSV.Settings.StreamUser.Name: Stream user
MSV.Settings.StreamUser.Hint: The player account logged in on the streaming machine. Its window is drawn as a grid of token viewpoints. It needs Observer permission on the tokens it should see through.
MSV.Settings.PaneZoom.Name: Pane zoom
MSV.Settings.PaneZoom.Hint: How many grid squares fit top to bottom in each pane. Lower is closer.
MSV.Settings.ShowFps.Name: Show frame rate on the stream
MSV.Settings.ShowFps.Hint: Displays the stream window's frame rate in its top-right corner. Useful while trying out pane counts.
MSV.Settings.ImageCloseAfter.Name: Close shared images after (seconds)
MSV.Settings.ImageCloseAfter.Hint: Images you show to players close on the stream after this long. 0 keeps them open until you clear them.
MSV.Settings.JournalCloseAfter.Name: Close shown journals after (seconds)
MSV.Settings.JournalCloseAfter.Hint: Journals you show to players close on the stream after this long. 0 keeps them open until you clear them.
MSV.Settings.CloseWithGm.Name: Close on the stream when you close yours
MSV.Settings.CloseWithGm.Hint: When you close an image or journal you showed, it closes on the stream too.
MSV.Settings.ShowCombat.Name: Show the combat carousel on the stream
MSV.Settings.ShowCombat.Hint: While a combat is running, the stream shows the turn order as portraits along the top middle.
MSV.Settings.CombatLimit.Name: Combatants in the carousel
MSV.Settings.CombatLimit.Hint: The current turn plus the next ones, up to this many. 0 shows everyone.
MSV.Panel.Title: Stream Panes
MSV.Panel.NoStreamUser: No stream user is set. Choose one in the module settings.
MSV.Panel.AutoHint: Follows the next observable token not used by another pane
MSV.Panel.UseSelected: Use the token you have selected
MSV.Panel.Clear: Back to an Auto token pane
MSV.Panel.NoObserver: {user} needs Observer permission on {token} to see through it.
MSV.Panel.Hidden: This token is hidden, so the stream can't see through it.
MSV.Panel.NothingSelected: Select a token on the canvas first.
MSV.Panel.Footer: Tokens listed are from {scene}. You can also drag an actor from the sidebar onto a pane. The stream window updates as soon as you change anything here.
